regions.merged_text: Just as a sord of P.S. Dear Friends "The O'Donnells". "The more hurry the less speed", the old say- ing could easily be applied to the other side of theis "document". I guess it hardly pays for an apprentice to speed up too much. Any how I thought you'd be pleased to know that I received quite an appreciative letter from M.C.C. I think what "raised his fethers" about my letter before, was my having quoted you as intimating that his heart-attack had possily left him ? not exactly himself. But really that feature just amused me. Otherwise it was a nice letter and quite indicative of a charitable feeling to the O'Donnells.

regions.merged_text: June 5th P.S. Just straightening up for our trip tomorrow P.M. I came across this carbon I thought was off last week am almost ashamed to send it. My nephew Bernard Maurice (Owen's Son) is with me since Monday. He will acompany me on his way to Seattle.
